description: Merged CAMT.053 entry point. Use mode='parse' to inspect a bank statement, mode='dry_run' to preview transaction import, or mode='execute' to create transactions after approval.

accounts_dimensions_id.description: Bank account dimension ID in e-arveldaja. Required for dry_run and execute modes.

date_from.description: Only import entries from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

date_to.description: Only import entries up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

file_path.description: Absolute path/base64 input. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

file_ref.description: Opaque Accounting Inbox CAMT file reference. Provide exactly one of file_path or file_ref.

mode.description: Workflow phase to run. Defaults to parse.

plan_handle.description: Execution-plan handle returned by the reviewed dry run. Required for mode='execute'.

name: process_camt053
title: Process CAMT.053
